structure.unit: Rabies Control and Licensing of Dogs and Cats

law.catch_line: Inoculation for rabies at public or private animal shelters
law.text: Dogs and cats being adopted from a public or private animal shelter during the period an emergency ordinance is in force, as provided for in § 3.2-6522, may be inoculated for rabies by a certified animal technician at such shelter if the certified animal technician is under the immediate and direct supervision of a licensed veterinarian.
